combo.description: In human form W away from yourself then R and use E to close the gap. AA W and use Q for burst damage, then instantly R E for the stun. Use human form Q and AA's to finish off the kill.
In human form W away from yourself then R E to close the gap. AA W and execute with Q.
To gank from close range in human form AA then use W E Q one after another. Go into spider form with R to execute with Q AA W.
To Flash gank start in Human form, Flash then instantly E W Q. Use R Q to gap close for your AA W.
Start off in human form AA Q then W behind you or to the side. Use E to stun your target before using R to go into spider form, then use your Q to make your original W fly to your target and AA W.
Your basic gank will start off in human form then E your target and instantly W Q. Follow this up with an quick R to go spider form, use Q to close the gap and AA W to AA reset to clean up the kill.
Start off in spider form then rappel to your target or a minion to gank. Use R to go human form so you can immediately E to stun, then W Q AA.
